notes: Memory: your own mistakes and your opening moves in one daily spaced-repetition review, each answer followed by the idea behind the move.
Woodpecker drill: solve the same set of puzzles on your weak spot again and again, faster each cycle.
Chessable is part of your coach: your Chessable courses with their due reviews show up in Openings, and Today's plan sends you to review or learn new moves in the right course.
Today's plan follows learning value (your last game, Memory, your weak spot, courses) with one focus theme per week.
Progress shows how well you remember, training days per week, Woodpecker cycle times and a blunder target for your goal.
A review only counts once you've actually gone through it; the plan bar shows finished steps itself; the coach never covers the review buttons.
Streak freeze: one missed day a week doesn't break your streak.
